sections.description: Build curated, SEO-friendly taxonomy archive pages with the WordPress block editor.
sections.changelog:
= 1.4.1 =
* Replaces the Category Pages admin menu icon with the Made to Thrive brand mark.
* Sizes the SVG on a 20-pixel square canvas while preserving its original proportions.

= 1.4.0 =
* Establishes the canonical Made to Thrive release and update channel.
* Includes the 1.3.0 short-description and term-field block binding features.
* Restores the 1.2.6 opt-in setting for showing curated content on paginated archives.
* Keeps automatic updates disabled unless the agency explicitly opts in.
* Raises the maintained release line to WordPress 6.9 and PHP 8.1.

= 1.3.0 =
* Adds a short archive description to taxonomy and Archive Page editing screens.
* Adds block bindings for archive taglines and generated recipe headings.
* Preserves category images when terms are updated through another workflow.

= 1.2.6 =
* Adds an opt-in setting for showing curated content on paginated archives.
